headline: GIC and Temasek Deny Allegations of Pressuring MSCI Over Indonesia Rating
summary: Singapore state investors Temasek and GIC dismissed claims that they lobbied index compiler MSCI to downgrade Indonesia, calling the allegations baseless and untrue.
why: Temasek and GIC manage hundreds of billions in global sovereign wealth, and MSCI index weightings drive massive institutional benchmark capital flows into emerging markets.

impacts.name: Indonesia
impacts.why: Rebuttals from major sovereign funds help dispel speculation around artificial benchmark index downgrades.
